source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = set()
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = frozenset((y-top, x-left) for y, x in cells)
            objects.append((color, cells, shape))
    partners = {shape: color for color, cells, shape in objects if color != 1}
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, cells, shape in objects:
        if color == 1 and shape in partners:
            new_color = partners[shape]
            for r, c in cells:
                out[r][c] = new_color
    return out
'''
